name: Pårte-Kvikkjokk
estimatedTime: 6-8 hours per STF; 5-8 hours per Naturkartan
description: Pårte to Kvikkjokk. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF says 6-8 hours; Naturkartan says 5-8 hours.

STF and Naturkartan stage pages say 17 km; STF Pårte facility page says about 16 km north of Kvikkjokk; computed geometry lengths are about 15.36-15.92 km and Naturvårdsverket representative feature length is about 16.4 km.
STF facility coordinates differ from Naturkartan and OSM route-line endpoints by about 100-231 m; Naturkartan and OSM end near different Kvikkjokk points.
Naturkartan API has line geometry but publish_gpx=false and no GPX/KML download found; Naturvårdsverket open data is official but duplicated/segmented.
Pårte is a Sarek/Laponia boundary-zone gateway; Laponia says Bårdde/Pårte cabins are just outside Sarek/Laponia, while nearby route context involves Sarek.
Several campsites/firepits are OSM-only; official sources support camping generally but not exact informal POIs.
Official sources mention the historic site, but no reliable coordinate was resolved.
